SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS dist_ids, MIN(order_ts_utc), MAX(order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_all, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS dist_ids FROM fact_web_order

WITH o AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
    AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS dist,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
                             WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND p.category='ZZ Test') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
                             WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND s.store_id=999) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s999_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS utc_date_count
FROM o
